title: tunnelmind:data_model:v1 — golden suite artifact
description: profile_artifacts/golden_questions.json: the golden suite. Per question only machine fields — query_sha256, the structured query (query.schema.json), golden_source, expected value and tolerance. No natural-language field exists (ATAP §7.6); every object sets additionalProperties:false.

query_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of `query`.

golden_source.description: Same enum as the gate_run golden_source in witness-events.schema.json.
